name: MineTime
summary:
MineTime is a fast-paced VR mining adventure that drops you into immersive environments filled with secrets, resources, and hidden paths waiting to be discovered. Using intuitive movement and interaction, you’ll explore unique areas, mine valuable materials, and unlock new gear and cosmetics as you progress.
